data.name: Asghari
data.gender_notes: Asghari is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root asghar, meaning 'close' or 'near'. This name is often given to a baby born near a significant event or place. The name Asghari carries the meaning “Near, Close” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asghari usually hope their child will grow to embody near, close and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asghari symbolizes being close to Allah and striving towards Him. It is a name that inspires a sense of closeness to the divine and a deep connection to spirituality.
data.etymology: Asghari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Near, Close.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asghari total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hindi.name: अस्ग़ारी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अस्ग़ारी नाम का उल्लेख मुहम्मदी में है। इसका मतलब है कि अल्लाह ने इसे एक लड़की के लिए विशेष बनाया है। इसका संबंध एक बड़े परिवार से है। इसका मतलब है कि इस लड़की का जन्म एक महान परिवार में हुआ था। इस नाम का उपयोग अहले सनत में होता है। इस नाम के कारण वह लड़की एक महान परिवार की सदस्य होती है।
